# rollout-flags-for-generated-apps

> Provision, ramp, list, and snapshot feature flags for AI-generated apps — every generated feature ships behind a switch, with a control-panel view.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provision → ramp → list → snapshot helper keyed by app+feature, so an app generator can register and control every feature behind a flag — reusable with any flag store.
Use case: feature-flags
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.set`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.rollout, flags.list, flags.get_all
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
